notes: TooltipView under node: env.node off, getDom stubbed; richText content on the zrender canvas.
position: TooltipRichContent.getSize is replaced by the case size; result = the moveTo argument (the box top-left, before the border and shadow offset moveTo adds to the text element).
shouldTooltipConfine: confine != null ? !!confine : the RAW renderMode option === 'richText' (default 'auto': false).
timers: a virtual clock; setTimeout / clearTimeout replaced for the run.
content: the richText lines parsed by segment style (width -> marker, weight 400 -> name, 900 -> value).

timers.note: showDelay 0, hideDelay 100 (the defaults): onto bar 1, off onto nothing, wait
off the bar twice: the second hide arms nothing (_show is already false), so the first timer stands
showDelay 50, the pointer leaves the canvas at 20: the show still comes at 50 and stays
the hide armed at 10 is due at 110: a move at 200 over nothing finds the box already gone
showDelay 50: a second move at 100 finds the first show done (anchor of the first), and waits again
hide pending, back onto another bar before it fires: the show clears it
showDelay 50: every move restarts the wait; the box shows where the LAST move was
showDelay 50, off the bar before it fires: hideLater does nothing (not shown yet) and the box shows at 50 and stays
alwaysShowContent: never hidden, not by nothing and not by leaving the chart
leaving the chart: hidden after hideDelay
an axis trigger: across categories, out of the grid, hideDelay 100
a series' showDelay 80 over the global 0 (the item's cascade); hideDelay is the global's
